name: Debbie Shrey
text: Jeff and his crew were very professional, punctual and very detailed in the job that they performed. When I spoke to Jeff about cleaning our ducts he told me that his office would call and set up the appointment with me and the next morning I had a call and an appointment. The day that they came to clean the ducts it was rainy so Jeff called me and said that they were going to wait an hour for the rain to stop, and 1 hour later they were in my driveway ready to work. When I got home from work I felt like I could breathe a much cleaner crisp air in my house. I would recommend Carolina Quality Air to everyone! Great group of hard working professionals.

name: Amanda Brewington
text: I am so grateful for this company! My father recently had a stem cell transplant and I needed to make sure the air quality in his home was very good before his return. These guys came to the rescue and did a wonderful job! I now don't have to worry about when he returns home. Thank you so much for your kindness and doing an excellent job!

name: Daniel Carrera
text: First time customer and this was my first time seeing duct cleaning performed. To start off Jeff showed up on time and had all the tools he needed to perform the job. He clearly explained what he was going to do and explained how long the process would take. His crew was nice enough to cover up any items that were located around my air vent and even vacuum everything up after they left. Super professional and they did an amazing job. Price wasn't that bad either and I even received a discount for paying cash. Would most definitely recommend.

name: Mike Shugart
text: Wish I could give 6 stars to show how pleased I was with Jeff and Nick's duct cleaning work. Top level training and accreditation. All questions were answered and Jeff spent time to go over needs and future care. Won't use anyone else.

name: Andrea Sauls
text: Wonderful, professional company!! They scheduled me within two days of calling and did a fantastic job! I would recommend them to anyone.

name: Doug Morse
text: The gentlemen who serviced this house did a thorough job and very friendly. Friendly, clean and efficient. Great job guys.
